content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 281 Posts
content_sections.text: RITES Limited has announced 281 apprenticeship vacancies across engineering, non-engineering, diploma and ITI trades. Graduate Engineering accounts for 125 posts, while Graduate Non-Engineering has 43 posts. The Other Trades category includes trades such as Welder, Fitter, Turner, Plumber and Surveyor. Candidates must select the apprenticeship opportunity matching their recognized ITI qualification. The official notification provides reservation for SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer, EWS and Persons with Benchmark Disabilities. However, the category-wise figures in the notified vacancy table contain an arithmetic discrepancy. The published grand-total row lists 32 SC, 12 ST, 68 OBC, 21 EWS and 144 UR vacancies, adding up to 277, whereas the notification advertises 281 total posts. Certain discipline-level category allocations also do not add up to their stated totals. Important: Candidates should follow the officially advertised 281-post recruitment total and consult any subsequent RITES corrigendum for clarification of the reservation breakup. PwBD reservation is horizontal and is included within the notified vacancies, not additional to them.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentices Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must possess the prescribed full-time engineering degree, non-engineering graduation, engineering diploma or ITI qualification in the relevant discipline. The qualification must be recognized by the applicable UGC, AICTE, NCVT or SCVT authority. Important: The 50% qualifying threshold applies to the notified reserved positions. Candidates applying against General or EWS positions must meet the applicable 60% requirement. Where the prescribed qualification specifies marks in the Honours subject, those marks will be used for eligibility. Otherwise, the aggregate marks of all subjects will be considered. Engineering and non-engineering graduates and diploma holders must have completed their qualifying course within the five-year period prescribed in the notification. No. Degree and diploma candidates whose final semester results were declared before 5 November 2021 are ineligible under this notification. This five-year passing-date restriction does not apply to ITI candidates. No. Candidates awaiting the result of their essential qualification as on 5 November 2026 are not eligible. The following candidates are not eligible: Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training. Candidates currently undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidates with one year or more of training after obtaining their essential qualification. Candidates with one year or more of post-qualification job experience. Candidates who have not completed the qualifying course by 5 November 2026. Candidates below 18 years of age on the eligibility cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must have completed at least 18 years of age as on 5 November 2026 . The notification does not provide a separate upper-age limit or category-wise age relaxation table. Applicants must satisfy the minimum age and all other applicable apprenticeship eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend between Rs. 10,560 and Rs. 15,650 , depending on their apprenticeship category. Stipend Clarification: The notified amounts are monthly apprenticeship stipends, not regular employee salaries. The Graduate and Diploma figures already include the applicable Government direct benefit transfer component; these amounts must not be added again.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training duration is one year for all four notified categories. RITES has expressly stated that the training period will not be extended. No. RITES expressly states that it has no obligation to offer employment during or after the apprenticeship period. Selection or inclusion in a merit list does not provide a right to apprenticeship engagement or subsequent permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection is based on percentage marks obtained in the essential qualification relevant to the selected apprenticeship trade . No written examination or interview will be conducted. NATS / NAPS Registration: Applicants complete the appropriate apprenticeship portal registration. Apprenticeship Application: Candidates apply for the RITES Limited opportunity through the relevant portal. RITES Document Submission: Applicants upload the prescribed supporting documents through the separate RITES form. Eligibility Verification: RITES reviews the submitted qualifications, category details and supporting certificates. Merit List: Eligible candidates are ranked using their qualifying examination percentage. Shortlisting: Candidates are selected according to the available apprenticeship vacancies. Joining and Original Document Verification: Shortlisted applicants must present original records when reporting. Apprenticeship Contract: Selected candidates complete their NATS or NAPS contract formalities. Merit is calculated using the percentage marks obtained in the prescribed essential qualification. Where the prescribed qualification specifies marks in the Honours subject, those marks will be used; otherwise, the aggregate of all subjects will be considered. If two candidates obtain the same qualifying examination percentage, the older candidate will be placed higher in the merit list. content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates can apply for the 281 RITES apprenticeship vacancies from 5 November to 25 November 2026. The application procedure involves two mandatory stages . Graduate and Diploma candidates must use the NATS portal, whereas ITI candidates must use NAPS. All applicants must then complete the RITES document submission form. Important: Candidates must apply for the RITES Limited establishment through NATS or NAPS before submitting the RITES form. Both procedures must be completed by 25 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RITES Apprentices Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the NATS portal if you are an Engineering Graduate, Non-Engineering Graduate or Diploma candidate. ITI candidates should visit the NAPS Apprenticeship India portal . Complete student or candidate registration if not already registered. Log in and complete the apprenticeship profile. Verify personal details, category, educational qualifications and aggregate percentage. Search the available apprenticeship opportunities using the establishment name RITES Limited . Select the relevant apprenticeship opportunity matching your qualification or trade. Submit the application through the appropriate portal. Save the NATS or NAPS application details and registration number. Visit the official RITES Apprentice Application Form . Complete the form using the information requested by RITES. Prepare all required educational qualification certificates and identity documents. Include the applicable category certificate where reservation is claimed. Include the university or institution's CGPA conversion formula where required. Combine all prescribed documents into one PDF file not exceeding 10 MB . Upload the combined PDF through the RITES application form. Indicate the preferred posting location if the form provides that option. Review the submitted information and document file carefully. Complete the form in a single submission by 25 November 2026 . Retain your apprenticeship registration and application details for future communication. Important: RITES does not accept multiple submissions of the document form. Supporting documents submitted by email or hard copy will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for RITES Apprentices Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: All prescribed supporting documents must be combined into one PDF. The combined PDF must not exceed 10 MB. Only one submission of the RITES application form is accepted. Documents sent by email are not accepted. Hard-copy document submissions are not accepted at the application stage. Documents not requested in the notification should not be uploaded. Applicants must submit the required documents by 25 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice OBC and EWS Certificate Requirements
content_sections.text: OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must submit a valid caste certificate in the prescribed Government of India Central format, issued on or after 5 November 2025 . EWS candidates must provide the latest applicable EWS certificate in the prescribed format. Candidates claiming SC, ST, OBC-NCL, EWS or PwBD reservation must submit valid documents supporting their claim.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice PwBD Reservation 2026
content_sections.text: The notification includes four PwBD reservation positions on a horizontal basis. Applicants seeking PwBD benefits must possess a certificate issued by the competent authority. Candidates must have at least 40% of the relevant disability and satisfy the physical requirements and functional classifications applicable to the selected apprenticeship position. PwBD reservation is included within the advertised vacancies and must not be added separately.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Posting Location 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship opportunities are available across India. Candidates from all states are eligible to apply, subject to the prescribed qualifications and other requirements. Applicants may provide their preferred location through the RITES application form. However, the final posting will be determined by the company's operational requirements. Important: A preferred location does not guarantee posting at that location. RITES will not entertain subsequent requests to change the posting preference after the prescribed process.

content_sections.heading: RITES Apprentice Merit List 2026
content_sections.text: RITES will prepare the merit list after examining apprenticeship applications submitted through NATS or NAPS and verifying documents submitted through the RITES form. Shortlisted candidates will receive instructions through email from [email protected] . The selected candidates list will also be uploaded on the official RITES website. Candidates must bring the original documents at the time of joining for further verification. Vacancies remaining unfilled after the initial shortlisting process may be filled from subsequent merit lists of eligible candidates.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of RITES Apprentice Applications
content_sections.text: Applicant is below 18 years as on 5 November 2026. Essential qualification result is pending on the cut-off date. Degree or diploma passing date is before 5 November 2021. Candidate has already completed or is undergoing apprenticeship training. Candidate has one year or more of post-qualification work or training experience. Minimum aggregate percentage requirement is not satisfied. Application is not submitted through the correct NATS or NAPS portal. Candidate fails to apply for the RITES Limited establishment. Mandatory RITES document form is not submitted. Required documents are missing or invalid. CGPA conversion formula is missing where applicable. OBC-NCL or EWS certificate does not meet the prescribed requirements. Application contains false or inconsistent information. Required original documents cannot be produced at joining.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 25 November 2026. Applications opened on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 281 vacancies: 125 Graduate Apprentice (Engineering), 43 Graduate Apprentice (Non-Engineering), 62 Diploma Apprentice, 51 Trade Apprentice (ITI Pass).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for RITES Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is candidates NOT completed 18 years of age as on cut-off date are not eligible.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 15,650 (Including DBT of Rs. 6150) for Graduate Apprentice (Engineering), 15,650 (Including DBT of Rs. 6150) for Graduate Apprentice (Non-Engineering), 13,450 (Including DBT of Rs. 5450) for Diploma Apprentice, 10,560 for Trade Apprentice (ITI Pass).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: B.Tech/B.E., Graduate, B.Sc, B.Com, BCA, BBA, depending on the post. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must meet the Physical Requirements and Functional Classifications as applicable for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates awaiting result for the Essential Qualification on the cut-off date. Candidates NOT completed 18 years of age as on cut-off date. Candidates who have undergone Apprenticeship Training earlier and/or pursuing Apprenticeship Training. Candidates who have undergone training or has job experience for a period of one year or more.
